title: introduce-init-slice-and-airgap-prewarm-values-with-namespace-compat-guards
author: Marisol Chen
description:
Context and motivation: Private deployments in heavily air-gapped environments often require a deterministic, controllable sequence for bootstrapping tenant data and pre-warming local registries. Existing init jobs were monolithic and could flood node pools (OOMs / image-pull storms) during large multi-tenant installs. This PR introduces an "init-slice" abstraction plus explicit airgap prewarm hooks and a namespace-compatibility guard to make installs safer, more predictable, and operator-friendly.

Summary of changes: 1) values.schema expansions: add `init.slice.enabled`, `init.slice.size`, `init.slice.mode` (tenant|global), and `airgap.prewarm.*` knobs (enabled, concurrency, pullPolicy, registrySecret). 2) templates: `init-slice.yaml` implements a slice iterator that creates N seed jobs per slice with backoff and optional leader-elector to serialize global slices. `hook-prewarm-image.yaml` is a conditional hook that runs before init-slices when `airgap.prewarm.enabled=true` and uses configured registry secrets. 3) `namespace-compatibility.yaml` is a small helper template that either creates tenant namespaces or maps to existing namespaces when `namespaceCompatibility.mode` is set to `legacy` (for clusters converted from older installers). 4) examples: `values.example.airgap.yaml` shows recommended defaults for on-prem installs with pre-pulled images and conservative slice sizes. 5) docs: update `charts/private/README.md` with operational guidance and migration notes for clusters previously using monolithic init jobs.

Commits (high level): - Add values.schema entries and examples: "add init.slice + airgap prewarm values" - Implement init-slice control loop template with leader-elector support: "init slice template + leader-elector" - Add prewarm hook and namespace compatibility helper + docs: "airgap prewarm hook + README"

Files changed (high level): - charts/private/values.schema.yaml: new schema blocks for init.slice and airgap.prewarm with descriptions, allowed values and defaults. - charts/private/templates/init-slice.yaml: new Job manifest with templated slice loop, `{{- if .Values.init.slice.enabled }}` guards, tolerations and resource queues for slice jobs. - charts/private/templates/hook-prewarm-image.yaml: annotated Helm hook for pre-install and pre-upgrade with optional concurrency and backoff. - charts/private/templates/namespace-compatibility.yaml: helper template to resolve namespace mapping. - charts/private/values.example.airgap.yaml: example prewarm registry secret and slice sizing for 50-tenant clusters. - charts/private/README.md: operations notes and migration checklist. - helmfile.d/airgap-prewarm.yaml: Helmfile entry for airgapped CI integration tests.

Testing and CI: Initial CI run flagged a linting error where the schema required `airgap.prewarm.concurrency` to be integer > 0; I fixed the schema and added unit-like template tests (helm template + `--values` smoke checks) into the existing chart test harness. On second run all checks passed: lint, template, kubeval (subset), and CI smoke tests for an example airgap values file.

Review conversation (summary, single-threaded): - Aisha: "Can we make slice.size a soft cap and ensure jobs don't all schedule at once? Also please add a template test that asserts the leader-elector annotations are present when mode=global." Author: "Added a preflight probe + leader-elector annotation check in the chart test harness and made slice scheduling respect `init.slice.maxConcurrent` (defaults to 2)." - Diego: "Tolerations look aggressive for some on-prem clusters — can you default to empty and allow cluster ops to opt-in? Also suggest a default backoff window." Author: "Changed tolerations to opt-in via `init.slice.tolerations` (empty by default) and set exponential backoff with jitter (initial 10s, max 5m). Updated README with recommended ops values for bare-metal." - Priya: "We need clear release notes and a migration path for clusters that relied on old init jobs." Author: "Added a migration section to README and a helper `namespaceCompatibility.mode=legacy` to preserve previous behavior. Also included a small helmfile entry for operators to dry-run the prewarm step."

Backward compatibility and migration: This change is additive and disabled by default (`init.slice.enabled=false`, `airgap.prewarm.enabled=false`). Migration steps are documented: operators can flip `init.slice.enabled=true` with conservative `slice.size` and `maxConcurrent` to ramp. For clusters that relied on previous implicit namespace creation, `namespaceCompatibility.mode=legacy` preserves behavior.

Operational notes: - For very large installs, set `init.slice.size` to number of tenants per slice (suggest 10-50 depending on node capacity). - Use `airgap.prewarm.concurrency` to limit simultaneous registry pulls (defaults to 3). - When using `mode=global` leader-elector will ensure only one slice performs global migration steps. - The prewarm hook is idempotent and annotated with a `pre-install` hook weight to run before any seed jobs.

Checklist: - [x] values.schema additions and validation - [x] template implementation with tests - [x] docs and examples - [x] CI green after fixes - [x] reviewers addressed comments

Merge outcome: Squash-merged into `main` after approvals from all reviewers.

Notes for release: see `release_notes` field for a short summary operators can include in their changelogs.
release_notes: Add optional init-slice for bootstrapping, optional airgap image prewarm hook, and namespace compatibility helper. Disabled by default; see README for migration steps and recommended default values for on-prem installs.
